title: Yummy Fluffy Chinese Chicken Grill
description: A jammy, fluffy chicken dish grilled to perfection with ras el hanout and a date syrup glaze, perfect for a low‑FODMAP date night.
instructions: Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Whisk together sesame oil, ginger, tamari, date syrup, ras el hanout, and lemon juice.
Pour the sauce over the chicken, coat evenly, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat a robata grill or grill pan over medium‑high heat.
Remove chicken from the fridge and let it come to room temperature for 10 minutes.
Grill the chicken for 6–7 minutes per side, basting with remaining sauce, until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Transfer the chicken to a plate, cover loosely with foil, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken into strips and drizzle with any leftover sauce from the grill.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and scallions before serving.
